_comment: Rift heart rewards per difficulty, endgame rematches and the heart rush (BossHall.gd, KAMPF_PLAN_1000 items 415, 417, 418). rewards: one row per difficulty (Story, Tamer, Veteran, Rift-Born): money factor on the heart's purse and the items a story heart win gives. echo: one rematch per heart, open after Act I once its Rift is mended (flag). rush: every open heart in a row with no rest; first clear gives reward once.
echo_intro: The mended heart still beats in the Rift's echo. It remembers you, and it is not grateful.
rush_intro: Every mended heart, one after another. No rest in between: your team keeps its wounds. Begin?
rush_line: Heart %d of %d is next. It heard the last one stop.
